method.name: rewind
method.description: Applies each named slot's state at [param tick] to its owner, runs [param body], and restores what it overwrote, unconditionally, on return. Answers how many slots were moved. A slot with no owner or no retained row at [param tick] is left at its live state and skipped, so the restore touches exactly the objects the rewind moved. Only the fields the retained row names and [method timeline_declare] declares are captured and put back: a field history never held is a field the rewind never wrote, and a field the slot never declared is one the rewind never touches even when the row carries it. What lands on the owner is the recorded value, which the recorder wrote in the wire's canonical form. What goes back is the live value exactly as it stood, so a rewind is not a quantization step the simulation pays for.

method.name: timeline_declare
method.description: Names the fields [param slot] owns, which is the filter [method rewind] captures and applies through. A slot that declares nothing falls back to the fields its retained row happens to carry, which is the right answer only while nothing else writes that row.

method.name: timeline_declared
method.description: The fields [param slot] declares, in declaration order, or an empty [Array] when it declares none.

method.name: timeline_entities
method.description: Every registered entity mapped to its [NetwTimeline], keyed by the entity itself. A slot whose entity reference has gone invalid is omitted.

method.name: timeline_register
method.description: Opens a timeline for [param entity] sized to [param history_limit] and returns its slot, or the slot already assigned when [param entity] is already registered. Sets [param entity]'s [code]timeline[/code] property to the returned [NetwTimeline]. Refuses a null [param entity] and returns [code]-1[/code].

method.name: timeline_registered
method.description: How many entities are currently registered.

method.name: timeline_sample_entity
method.description: [method timeline_sample] for the slot registered to [param entity], or an empty [Dictionary] when [param entity] is not registered.

method.name: timeline_slot_of
method.description: The slot registered to [param entity], or [code]-1[/code] when it is not registered.

method.name: timeline_unregister
method.description: Closes the timeline registered to [param entity] and releases its slot. Does nothing when [param entity] is not registered.
